## This work (Р-217)

The Russian Starter Set (official edition, Hobby World) — each scenario is its own registered PDF **without a text layer** (scans): «Бумажный след» `starter-paper-chase-ru` (12 pages), «Грань тьмы» `starter-edge-of-darkness-ru` (31), «Мертвецкий стомп» `starter-dead-mans-stomp-ru` (28). Read pages by OCR — `pdftoppm -r 200 -f N -l N -png <pdf> <out>` then `tesseract <png> - -l rus` — and check every number on the page image; find the printed/physical page relation of your PDF and report it. Official Russian handouts — `…\Стартовый набор (Starter Set)\Раздатка\` and the jpg folders `Бумажный след\`, `Грань Тьмы\`, `Мертвецкий Стомп\` (images; OCR). The pre-generated investigators already exist in `kb/books/startovyy-nabor-pregens-ru/` — link them, never duplicate. Model of a scanned official Russian scenario: `kb/books/dveri-vo-tmu-ru/scenarios/darkness-beneath-the-hill.json` and its report `checks/20261112-doors-darkness-hill/darkness.md`. Run tools as `python -B …`.

- Russian text: as printed (official; no `translated`); English names in `name.en` only if certain (Paper Chase, The Edge of Darkness, Dead Man Stomp).
- Records — book-scoped `<book_id>/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/<book_id>/<kinds>/` of your scenario's book: scenario record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene retold for play (`arc`), items, handouts, organizations, characters (statblocks as printed, Р-25), creatures (known Mythos creatures → `instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:*`), places. Cities — shared records (Arkham, New York with Harlem, Boston… exist or create, Р-190), the scenario's places as book records `part_of` them, places outside a city under «Окрестности <города>» (Р-209). Maps — `map` with the image (`app/maps/starter-<slug>.jpg`) and spots on every printed number/label (Р-206; check each by eye on a crop); every key number gets a place record. List captions — neutral, no spoilers (Р-209).
- `axes.era` ["1920s"], `ruleset` "core". Book misprints — `errata` as printed (Р-35).
- Coverage: `checks/20261112-starter-set/<unit>.md` — every heading → record(s), «не взято» with the reason.
